decision: Built the frame: vertical MVP across all 6 milestones, engine-first
why: engine is the riskiest unknown; tests are the lever a reviewer reruns; spec ch54 MVP
result: done-when: test+build+e2e green, real browser loop proven

decision: Scaffolded Next 16.3.3 + TS + Tailwind v4 + App Router via create-next-app
why: repo was empty; network works; engine lives in src/game as pure TS

decision: Built 18-module pure-TS engine and 49 Vitest tests green
why: journeys embedded on TrainState (not a separate store); seeded RNG; train-local TrainStats; advance() rides day boundaries + candidates to NEXT EVENT
evidence: typecheck clean, lint clean, 9 test files/49 tests pass, playthrough deterministic

decision: Added npm scripts test/test:watch/typecheck and vitest.config.ts
why: make verification runnable; leverage builds itself (spec ch47)

decision: Prisma 8-rc init pulled in the Prisma Cloud Composer stack; reverted it and pinned prisma CLI to 7.10.0 to match @prisma/client, using the classic ORM + local SQLite
why: Composer is for Prisma Cloud apps, not a local SQLite engine; matching CLI+client versions avoids rc surprises

decision: Prisma 7 needs datasource url in prisma.config.ts (defineConfig) plus a driver adapter at runtime (@prisma/adapter-better-sqlite3); schema omits url from the datasource block
why: Prisma 7 split connection config out of schema.prisma; P1012 otherwise; better-sqlite3+adapter bundles the DB engine at 7.10.0
evidence: prisma.config.ts, prisma/schema.prisma, .env, db push green, node smoke roundtrip

decision: Whole-Game JSON doc per User (schemaVersion 1) stored in Game.stateJson; every server action rehydrates with parseState, mutates, atomic replace; leaderboard is a derived 1:1 snapshot with gameId @unique
why: State is deep; diffing is undo-driven complexity; whole-doc replace makes every action idempotent and trivially dumpable

decision: Cookie-less stateless auth: bcryptjs hash + HMAC-SHA256 signed tg_session cookie (userId.mac), no session table; proxy.ts gates /game, /login, /register guest-only
why: No shared secrets persistence beyond SESSION_SECRET env; Next 16 proxy replaces middleware; avoids DB session table + cleanup

decision: 13 server actions returning ActionResult; GameShell 9-tab mobile UI; Onboard + demo snapshot; TutorialOverlay with localStorage dismiss
why: Server actions keep mutation next to repo; single JSON doc makes revalidation trivial; tutorial dismissals are per-browser preference not game state
result: layout audit: no h-overflow on any tab @390px

decision: Tutorial step state moved from setState-in-effect to deferred setTimeout to satisfy react-hooks/set-state-in-effect; lazy initializer rejected (hydration mismatch)
why: lint requires no sync setState in effect body; lazy init causes server-null vs client-0 mismatch

decision: Playwright chromium E2E at 390x844: register -> onboard -> advance -> tabs walk -> logout/login persistence; scripts must wait for hydration before submit and use force clicks (dev overlay intercepts)
why: Durable repro of the live gameplay loops; earlier failures traced to duplicate email across runs (Date.now()%100000) and pre-hydration form submits
evidence: playwright.config.ts, e2e/core-loop.spec.ts, git history of test-results

decision: GitHub Actions workflow (ci.yml): npm ci -> prisma db push -> test -> typecheck -> lint -> build -> playwright chromium E2E against `next start`; USE_PRODUCTION_SERVER flips webServer command
why: Repo now on GitHub; CI is the rerunnable lever for the whole verification stack; E2E needs a real build+browser not dev server
result: workflow written; E2E green against prod build locally

decision: E2E vs dev vs prod differ: bare text= locators match the Next route announcer (#__next-route-announcer__) element in prod; switched welcome assertion to getByRole('heading', ...)
why: Prod build injects an aria-live announcer mirroring headings; text locators become strict-mode violations

decision: Switched persistence from local SQLite to hosted Postgres for Vercel: provider=postgresql, @prisma/adapter-pg, prisma.config uses env('DATABASE_URL'), offline initial migration committed, prebuild generates client, db:deploy runs migrate deploy, CI runs a postgres:17 service container end to end
why: Vercel serverless FS is read-only except /tmp (SQLite cannot persist); whole-game is one JSON text column so the swap was near-zero
result: generate/typecheck/lint/test/build all green locally; E2E + real-PG verified in CI

decision: Session cookie secure flag must derive from x-forwarded-proto, not NODE_ENV: over plain http on a non-localhost host Chromium drops a Secure cookie, so newGameAction's request carried no session, proxy 307'd /game->/login, and game creation failed (games=0 while users grew)
why: secure: NODE_ENV==='production' is wrong for http LAN/dev; Vercel sends x-forwarded-proto: https so the flag stays Secure there, and http LAN gets secure=false
evidence: src/lib/auth.ts (headers().get('x-forwarded-proto')), ss+ps forensics on stale next-server, LAN smoke
result: LAN register->Start my railroad->Dispatch Desk green; game row persisted; prod E2E still 2/2
